panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 4 panels (A, B, C, D). A: Preoperative right oblique clinical photo of 34-year-old female with Barraquer Simons syndrome showing severe facial lipoatrophy with hollow cheeks, matching article title and caption. B: Preoperative left oblique clinical photo of same patient showing severe facial lipoatrophy, attributed to Barraquer Simons syndrome by title and caption. C: Preoperative front view clinical photo showing severe facial lipoatrophy with sunken cheeks in Barraquer Simons syndrome case. D: Preoperative worm's eye view clinical photo showing severe facial lipoatrophy in same Barraquer Simons syndrome patient.

in_text_mentions: The second patient, a female aged 34 years old had severe facial lipoatrophy which was a cause of distress, as her appearance was often mistaken for anorexia nervosa—or, in some instances acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS) (Fig. 3). This faulty attribution of the underlying causes of her appearance ultimately led to social problems.Fig. 3Preoperative images of a 34 years old female with severe facial lipoatrophy. A Preoperative right oblique view, B Preoperative left oblique view, C Preoperative front view, D Preoperative right worms eye view

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 5 panels (A, B, C, D, E). A: Preoperative clinical photo of 29yo female with Barraquer-Simons syndrome; caption and in-text state breast atrophy/atrophic breast tissue with asymmetry/ptosis, visible as loss of upper trunk/breast fat consistent with cephalothoracic lipoatrophy. B: Preoperative left oblique view of same patient; caption and in-text state breast atrophy/atrophic breast tissue with asymmetry/ptosis, visible loss of upper trunk/breast fat. C: Preoperative front view of same patient; caption and in-text state breast atrophy/atrophic breast tissue, visible with asymmetry especially left side, consistent with upper trunk fat loss. D: Preoperative right side view of same patient; caption and in-text state breast atrophy/atrophic breast tissue, visible loss of upper trunk/breast fat. E: Preoperative right side view of same patient; caption and in-text state breast atrophy/atrophic breast tissue, visible loss of upper trunk/breast fat.

panels.figure_caption: Preoperative images of a 29 years old female with facial lipoatrophy combined with breast atrophy. A Preoperative left side view, B Preoperative left oblique view, C Preoperative front view, D Preoperative right side view, E Preoperative right side view
in_text_mentions: A female aged 29, complained of atrophic breast tissue. For her facial lipoatrophy, she underwent lipofilling at another clinic. Thorough examinations and laboratory analyses, the patient was found to be in overall good health. She had asymmetries on the breast forming breast ptosis, especially on the left side (Fig. 5).Fig. 5Preoperative images of a 29 years old female with facial lipoatrophy combined with breast atrophy. A Preoperative left side view, B Preoperative left oblique view, C Preoperative front view, D Preoperative right side view, E Preoperative right side view
